newsitem.title: POLAND: Credis, PKO BP mutual fund eyes '97 start.
newsitem.headline: Credis, PKO BP mutual fund eyes '97 start.

text.p: Swiss-Polish mutual fund company Credis/PKO BP Polsko-Szwajcarskie Towarzystwo Funduszy Powierniczych plans to introduce its first product in Poland sometime this year, a company spokesman said on Friday.
"We expect the fund to bring its first product to market this year," Antoni Leonik told Reuters, adding that no financial details were currently available.
The firm also said in a statement on Friday that it would first launch a balanced fund and would follow it with other products in the near future.
The statement said Credis and state-owned PKO BP, Poland's largest retail bank, each held an even share of the firm.
On Thursday the Polish Securities Commission (KPW) approved for operation the company and its operating of a balanced fund.
